approval: User approved proceeding with a new 300-credit ceiling, including capability checks.
isolation: Fresh per-arm sandboxes under /tmp/opencode/astra-build-20260907, outside all Git repositories. Same installed global OpenCode configuration and skills for both arms. No production configuration edits.
budget_control: Sequential dispatches; ledger_admit before each capability check (20 credits projected) and workload (75 credits projected); reconcile after each dispatch; stop on missing cost or inadequate reserve. These are conservative admission estimates, not provider-side hard limits; in-flight cost is only reported on completed model steps. No automatic retries or replacement pairs.
pricing: Standard catalog rates, USD per million tokens: Astra input/output/cache-read 10/50/1; Opus 5/25/0.5. Credits derived using existing dispatcher: summed step_finish costs in USD multiplied by 100. Not independently verified against the billing UI.
decision_rule: Reuse phase3-build-gpt-preflight.json final_adoption_rule, substituting Astra for Sol. Any functional regression keeps Opus; a functional improvement follows the earliest differentiating criterion across workloads. A functional tie requires Astra to be faster on BOTH workloads with (max-min)/mean strictly greater than 0.378885. Cost is observational only. Missing valid evidence is inconclusive, keeping Opus operationally.
invalid_attempt_policy: Retain valid controller failures, including approval stops. INVALID_ENVIRONMENT invalidates the pair; no replacement is automatically authorized by this four-run protocol. Fixture defects stop adjudication.
activation: No production routing change regardless of outcome. A win is evidence for further evaluation; GPT Build with the existing GPT reviewer needs a separate family-separation decision.
limitations: Two tiny Bash workloads, one dispatch per model per workload; screening only.
Timing threshold is inherited from a different fixture family, not a statistical significance threshold.
Non-interactive single-shot contract includes installed skills and their approval gates.
Same variant label does not establish equal reasoning compute.
Global skills and runtime differ from historical runs; compare the contemporaneous arms, not historical wall-clock figures.
